# Oikos: Prepare GovOne-approved reproducible Colab exports with spending holdback

## Context

Planning only for private open-hax/oikos at /home/err/spaces/foresight/oikos. Desktop is a local-first shared workbench. Initial incoming proposal; planning review is not complete. Creation authorizes no implementation, live configuration, deployment, inference, upload or spending. This focused slice belongs to Oikos: consented labels and bounded Colab training corpus.

## Outcome

Prepare GovOne-approved reproducible Colab exports with spending holdback.

## Scope

Implement allowlisted reproducible JSONL/VLM export with coordinate/model/template/license metadata and an unexecuted bounded research plan.

## Non-goals

No new compute-unit spending, automatic training, automatic production adoption, private screenshot export or assumption old budget transfers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] GovOne inspection plus explicit human approval are required before Google/Colab export; cloud consent is not implied by local labels.
- [ ] Fresh campaign budget, resource and teardown proofs are mandatory; no transfer of prior pilot budget, new CU spend, automatic training or production adoption.
- [ ] Link existing bounded pilot uuid and parent da84a64d-f118-4722-8709-a1c556034f90 as context, not completion/adoption authority.

## Verification

Dry-run synthetic exports reproduce hashes/coordinates; deny missing consent/policy/approval/budget and uncertain teardown; prove zero allocation in this planning scope. These are future acceptance checks, not executed implementation evidence.

## Risks

Cloud training exposes private data and can consume nonrefundable CU; historical pilot authority does not transfer to this corpus.

## Source anchors

Dated planning evidence: 2026-11-03. Operator requirements are reported intent, not live runtime proof. Cross-repository absolute paths identify source ownership, not a promotion of domain authority.
